image_description: A wooden rain barrel with metal bands sits against a light-colored stone wall. A black downspout descends from the top right, curving into an inlet on the side/top of the barrel. To the left is a textured wooden fence or post. The barrel has a rustic appearance with visible wood grain and two dark metal hoops.
